annotations.title: Match a deal to commercial mortgage programs

description: Rank the commercial mortgage programs (agency, FHA/HUD, bank, credit union, life company, CMBS, bridge, debt fund, DSCR, construction and more) that fit a deal, with the reasons and cautions for each, today's indicative rate (live index plus the program's published spread), and an estimate of the largest loan each program's published LTV/LTC, DSCR and debt-yield limits allow. Programs that do not fit are listed with the reason. Same rules as the site's /find-your-loan/ matcher.

cost.description: Total project cost in dollars, for construction (land plus hard and soft costs, for LTC).

credit.description: Sponsor credit: strong, fair (some blemishes) or challenged (recent bankruptcy, foreclosure or serious late payments). Default strong.

credit_tenant.description: True if one creditworthy tenant leases the whole building long term.

existing_balance.description: Balance of the existing first loan, in dollars. Supplemental loans are sized on combined debt, so they need it.

existing_loan.description: For a refinance: the current loan (agency = Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac, fha = FHA-insured). Needed for supplemental and 223(a)(7) loans.

existing_payment.description: Monthly payment on the existing first loan, in dollars (for the combined coverage test on a supplemental loan).

ground_lease.description: True if the property sits on a ground lease.

limit.description: How many ranked programs to return (default 6).

multiple_properties.description: True to finance several properties in one loan.

noi.description: Annual net operating income in dollars (for DSCR and debt yield).

occupancy.description: stabilized (leased up, steady income), transitional (lease-up or value-add) or vacant. Default stabilized.

owner_occupied.description: True if the borrower's own business occupies the building.

property.description: Property type: multifamily, mixed-use, retail, office, medical-office, industrial, self-storage, manufactured-housing, hotel, senior-housing, student-housing, affordable-housing, special-purpose, land.

purpose.description: purchase, refinance (rate and term), cash-out, construction, bridge (value-add or lease-up), renovation.

recourse.description: Non-recourse required, preferred, or any. Default any.

timeline.description: Closing need: urgent (under 30 days), soon (30 to 60), normal (60 to 90), flexible. Default flexible.

units.description: Apartment units, for multifamily (5 to 50 units also matches small-balance programs).

value.description: Property value or purchase price in dollars (for LTV).
